{{Quote|Every so-called Jedi on Tython is going to die. That's a promise. Your entire order is weak. You've done nothing to stop the Sith Empire's advances.|Bengel Morr promises to destroy the Padawan|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was ordered to '''disable''' a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]], a region controlled by the hostile [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. While a strike force of Jedi prepared to attack the natives' [[Flesh Raider command base|command base]], which was protected by the shield generator, Din's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] ventured into the Ridge mountains to locate and shut down the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]. Successfully fighting through the Flesh Raider forces, the apprentice deactivated the shield and allowed Din to lead the strike [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|against the command base]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I'm on my way back to the Twi'lek settlement. Meet me there soon as you can.''"<br />"''You left without saying anything. What has you so worried?''"<br />"''I'll explain when I see you. Find me at the Matriarch's compound. Orgus out.|Orgus Din and his Padawan|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] began attacking in greater numbers<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref> under the influence of two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]&mdash;[[Bengel Morr]]<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> and [[Callef]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> The [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] apprentice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], Morr had been inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], and had gone insane after witnessing the of the devastation. When his body was not recovered, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assumed he was dead, but Morr turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and took on Callef as his apprentice. The two spent the next ten years plotting the downfall of the Jedi, influencing the Flesh Raiders against the Order.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

The [[Hero of Tython|new apprentice]] of Din, who had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Callef in an [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|earlier encounter]],<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> was sent by Din to the ruins of the ancient temple of [[Kaleth]] to investigate recent activity in the area. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] had also rescued an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] designated [[T7-O1]] while [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|recovering weapons]] for the [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had recorded a hooded figure giving orders to Callef.<ref name="High-Tech Savages">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|High-Tech Savages|Tython}}</ref> Orgus Din had recognized the figure, but would not tell his apprentice who it was before sending the Padawan to Kaleth.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

While at Kaleth, the Padawan encountered [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielding]] Flesh Raiders, and was forced to [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|defeat them]] when they attacked. Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]], who had arrived as reinforcements for the Padawan, was alarmed to find that [[Flesh Raider Ravager Chieftain|the leader]] had been carrying a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], and instructed the apprentice to install [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]] in the area so the Order would know if the natives returned. The Padawan was then contacted by Din via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], who ordered his apprentice to return to Kalikori village.<ref name="Enemy Force" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|You up for knocking out the power generator?''"<br />"''When have I ever let you down?''"<br />"''First time for everything&mdash;not that I'm worried.|Orgus Din and his Padawan|<ref name="Enemy Force" />}}
[[File:Tythos_Ridge_High.png|thumb|left|230px|The [[Tythos Ridge]]]]
When the Padawan arrived, Din revealed what he had been holding back: the identity of Callef's master, Bengel Morr. However, Morr was not the issue at the moment&mdash;the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ranna Tao'Ven]], the daughter of the deathly ill [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Sumari]], had received information from her scouts about the location of a [[Flesh Raider command base]] in the native-controlled [[Tythos Ridge]] mountains. Unfortunately for the Jedi, the base was located several miles away and was protected by a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. The shield generator was located in a cave system in a different mountain nearby, and the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] needed to go down before the Jedi could attack.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

Din tasked his Padawan with disabling the shield while he gathered a team of Jedi to [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|eliminate]] the base. Leaving the village, the apprentice fought through the Flesh Raider&ndash;infested territory of the Tythos Ridge, heading up the mountain paths toward the cave where the generator was located. Despite the presence of many Flesh Raiders and a trained [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] in the cave, the Padawan was able to defeat their [[Flesh Raider Chieftain|chieftain]] and reach the generator console. However, upon the shield's deactivation, the Padawan was contacted by Bengel Morr himself.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Hmm. You must be the Padawan who slaughters my people. Your misguided attacks change nothing. Your time is over.|Bengel Morr|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
[[File:Bengel_Morr_Holo.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Bengel Morr contacts the Padawan]]
Morr told the Padawan of his interest in the young Jedi, but was ultimately confident that nothing would be able to stop his plans. The Nautolan also revealed his goal in instigating the uprising: he, like his apprentice Callef, believed the Jedi Order had become weak and needed to be replaced. Morr and Callef were training the Flesh Raiders to destroy the Order and rebuild it into something stronger. This new Order would be able to take the fight to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], wiping them from existence. Despite the Padawan's attempts to convince Morr to come back for healing, the Dark Jedi ended the transmission. Concerned about Morr's plans, the Padawan rushed back to Kalikori Village to find Master Din and warn him.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The raid represents the events of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class story mission "The Face of the Enemy", where the player is sent by Orgus Din, Ranna Tao'Ven, and Moorint to the Tythos Ridge to shut down the shield generator so the Jedi can attack the Flesh Raider base on another mountain. After deactivating the shield and talking with Morr, the next stage of the quest is to return to Kalikori Village to seek out Din.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
